in_arabic.name: أسفَق

historical_references.reference: Al-Maqrizi's 'Kitab al-Khitat' records that Asfaq was a vizier under the Hafsid ruler Abu Ibrahim, and played a significant role in the political intrigues and power struggles of 14th-century Tunisia.
